first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A yellow low-profile sports car in the foreground, with a dark rear panel, a large red rear wing, and red circular light clusters on both sides.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: A white low-profile sports car ahead of Vehicle A, with a horizontal rear wing, a dark rear window, and red taillights.

entities.name: racetrack surface
entities.identification: The gray paved racetrack extending from the lower part of the image into the distance.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The blue-gray sky above the trees and mountains, with relatively little texture.

entities.name: orange-lit tunnel entrance
entities.identification: The orange-yellow arch-shaped bright opening at the far end of the road, behind the gantry.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: The alternating red-and-white segmented curb repeatedly arranged along the edge of the racetrack.

entities.name: green runoff area
entities.identification: The continuous green strip-shaped paved area along the outer edge of the racetrack.

entities.name: concrete racetrack barrier
entities.identification: The continuous low solid gray wall outside the green runoff area.

entities.name: metal racetrack guardrail
entities.identification: The continuous guardrail composed of parallel silver-gray horizontal bars on the right side of the racetrack.

entities.name: racetrack safety fence
entities.identification: The mesh fence above the barrier, supported by tall gray posts, with the tops of some posts inclined.

entities.name: trees around the outside of the racetrack
entities.identification: The contiguous dark green trees around the outside of the racetrack, with crowns of varying heights.

entities.name: distant mountain
entities.identification: The undulating gray-green mountain ridge behind the trees, with parts of the mountain face appearing light gray.

entities.name: racetrack grandstand
entities.identification: The long grandstand behind the fence, with gray steps and horizontal tiers of seating.

entities.name: racetrack sign and display screen
entities.identification: An input set consisting of billboards, distant vertical signs, and roadside illuminated display screens.

entities.name: roadside lattice tower
entities.identification: The slender gray lattice tower beside the display screen, with multiple tiers of horizontal members at the top.

entities.name: gantry spanning the racetrack
entities.identification: The dark gate-shaped structure spanning the road in the distance, with light-colored logos and lettering on its crossbeam.

entities.name: group of spectators in the grandstand
entities.identification: The set of background spectators arranged in rows within the grandstand seating, without tracking individuals.
